==Notes==
*This skill will remove existing Disease when applied, although this is not stated in its description. This is similar to other [[Skill quick reference#Skills that provide immunity to a condition|skills that provide immunity to a condition]], except for [[Frigid Armor]].
*The life stealing occurs before the attack, but still requires a successful hit.
*All [[action]]s (including skill activations, attacks, and movement) will be [[cancel]]ed when this form ends.
*This form uses male [[necromancer]] animations, regardless of your [[character]]'s gender or profession.
*The [[hero]] [[M.O.X.]] has a unique model for this form. If you look closely, you can see a skull in his chest.

== Trivia ==
